Spicy food does **not** cure a hangover, and it often makes stomach symptoms worse. Only time, sleep, and hydration actually resolve a hangover.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF16PhpirKcKVIbMS-qrOSTgMri6M_f0tnYMmfY3SuUOoiNnv6CWPt3QWVVhAbTtQXQLAJqOVx57eMokDPAAdU_nZ69nhQDNFiSwBtaNyc0ydutp-W5zGRjLUBjK2gvyQ55-GO8e2tAnnUF_NiSD30-Ghaa1Bz8Ljtki6OS40mVTmFgw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF19TGxuCz8QKJ5SjicaySoNzCI2dQOfc50gfTpA41a6KtcsafG2mSl2UcXVkSa4B2RV-IZYZOEJRSUitUxO1qo5dsJC3bg3nhiC96HZiUheswoA1FTo7H29JWE_BUBb-cuJWSO8SxcZYKRsBnUBxrtjnQ06lMxepYw5b3POApghIzQwx9)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF17J2AezZH2Bv8ADo-qxHMMugTlmepqua74d3zLEbo-i2AB_5O8kauwRp7KlNvzsbh1wiM5zCH-IE5uAMHVIfA0OYcv8BgCaHSSDQPOo2WU_TUhWFyDJwTEOPQhZgIg3ySYRWsS93RBmo2nOEeU4qfi2v-TO2zViCdG4s6O1kaSmzURJnPJj0sQJH-xKRbIetpoP-eB-1UMAOPRAB8A)

### Why Spicy Food Can Make It Worse

- **Stomach irritation:** Alcohol irritates and inflames your stomach lining. Spicy foods can increase discomfort, heartburn, acid reflux, and nausea.
- **Low spice tolerance:** If spicy food normally upsets your stomach, eating it while hungover is likely to backfire.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF16PhpirKcKVIbMS-qrOSTgMri6M_f0tnYMmfY3SuUOoiNnv6CWPt3QWVVhAbTtQXQLAJqOVx57eMokDPAAdU_nZ69nhQDNFiSwBtaNyc0ydutp-W5zGRjLUBjK2gvyQ55-GO8e2tAnnUF_NiSD30-Ghaa1Bz8Ljtki6OS40mVTmFgw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoQEBxCJF17J2AezZH2Bv8ADo-qxHMMugTlmepqua74d3zLEbo-i2AB_5O8kauwRp7KlNvzsbh1wiM5zCH-IE5uAMHVIfA0OYcv8BgCaHSSDQPOo2WU_TUhWFyDJwTEOPQhZgIg3ySYRWsS93RBmo2nOEeU4qfi2v-TO2zViCdG4s6O1kaSmzURJnPJj0sQJH-xKRbIetpoP-eB-1UMAOPRAB8A)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF1-n-7y17UdrCK34AUJvJ7MzMidQEPg0QDqZhqxsV36rZ5VK5AoAoaNIgfwyeoKdsoywL-Wm2ze3YQ7h9yYesQ1sXKlKb6VodVKZE9F3ab6EA8-vWDePTevK-HAh8egVGImN2WoON8z-mibqa5ifzCL30Obh_A0oynxaEJ35L8b69v81wr4PFM9yCfcXYLg)

### Why Some People Still Like It

- **Hydration and alertness:** Eating spicy food can prompt you to drink more water and temporarily clear sinuses or distract from sluggishness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXl-gs13Gv-AO7KNDhvkgJOlTCNv-lV5MU1XDwgsFlZPBknIS8Tb78pr9vuhIBOloC3QyZI42AFOrV53POmwoCFs6-gP_Eq20EccUUDt3mIX0ny3j7hUl2MlVKk3nsHA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1_SWIbYWgV1stv5idripE7WRGv9TG95N_n779YhTPwpm9fOEGjBbpGM7hnRLUNw-XN3tguAFPLmbyrUZKiIUqM21xFaVhVgKRffFon_wt6ZrlCjtnH1TBnRQS9P1t-AiJUzG_fFfaW2SrM_mTq4_fa4Ui4ALTeu2Ifh22A)
- **Mixed experiences:** Opinions on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1xLutRhhIVtbDkSQ8OVr_qe16P0fXqKNeAM9Pjrh2xmD9UN2TNb-7yuLAS6B8dq9xT93Cdce0wrJLrjmMGKnYzj0xVuOYxokhvqx3IOOSPt5-XVhjfsp4uhR95LO59tXICdNc9C7S98SqsPFx4Ag9elneT5kcMH_qSZvaIE) are mixed—some users say spicy dishes like pho with Sriracha help them feel better, while others say it doesn't help or worsens morning-after symptoms . Cultural hangover soups and stews (such as Korean *haejangguk* , ramen, or Mexican *menudo* ) are also popular traditions, though they don't speed up alcohol recovery.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF19TGxuCz8QKJ5SjicaySoNzCI2dQOfc50gfTpA41a6KtcsafG2mSl2UcXVkSa4B2RV-IZYZOEJRSUitUxO1qo5dsJC3bg3nhiC96HZiUheswoA1FTo7H29JWE_BUBb-cuJWSO8SxcZYKRsBnUBxrtjnQ06lMxepYw5b3POApghIzQwx9)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1xLutRhhIVtbDkSQ8OVr_qe16P0fXqKNeAM9Pjrh2xmD9UN2TNb-7yuLAS6B8dq9xT93Cdce0wrJLrjmMGKnYzj0xVuOYxokhvqx3IOOSPt5-XVhjfsp4uhR95LO59tXICdNc9C7S98SqsPFx4Ag9elneT5kcMH_qSZvaIE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXRIiUM0-SNbSdDbq0faPZyGU5Y_mFokG2VHBV2PeLQ_YzjpaO1gzuB3phpA2eEk8edme2F127tk1ojJVeljOvfjuK2KfwllIncmhxI9hRiSjJ8qTNxwkhBPJ6D0J9cStlT0cxNpos2Crxbg27OleKyr3954S2EX5o)

### Better Options for Recovery

- Focus on water, electrolyte fluids, and gentle, easy-to-digest foods. You can check [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF16PhpirKcKVIbMS-qrOSTgMri6M_f0tnYMmfY3SuUOoiNnv6CWPt3QWVVhAbTtQXQLAJqOVx57eMokDPAAdU_nZ69nhQDNFiSwBtaNyc0ydutp-W5zGRjLUBjK2gvyQ55-GO8e2tAnnUF_NiSD30-Ghaa1Bz8Ljtki6OS40mVTmFgw) for ideas like coconut water, bananas, pear juice, ginger, and salmon for hangover symptom relief.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF16PhpirKcKVIbMS-qrOSTgMri6M_f0tnYMmfY3SuUOoiNnv6CWPt3QWVVhAbTtQXQLAJqOVx57eMokDPAAdU_nZ69nhQDNFiSwBtaNyc0ydutp-W5zGRjLUBjK2gvyQ55-GO8e2tAnnUF_NiSD30-Ghaa1Bz8Ljtki6OS40mVTmFgw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF19TGxuCz8QKJ5SjicaySoNzCI2dQOfc50gfTpA41a6KtcsafG2mSl2UcXVkSa4B2RV-IZYZOEJRSUitUxO1qo5dsJC3bg3nhiC96HZiUheswoA1FTo7H29JWE_BUBb-cuJWSO8SxcZYKRsBnUBxrtjnQ06lMxepYw5b3POApghIzQwx9)
